description:
Skill Summary: 
 This person will be responsible for administration, design, testing, content migration, reporting, and support of various SharePoint 2013 sites and SharePoint applications (InfoPath). In addition, the person will design, develop, and support various back-end databases (SQL Server, SSMS, SSAS [Tabular Data Models]) supplying information to the SharePoint sites, as well as SharePoint reporting components such as SSRS, PowerPivot, PowerView, etc.) 

 This individual will work on the following kinds of assignments: 

 Build SharePoint site/subsite, with assorted Web-Parts
 Build ETL system to provide back-end data for SharePoint
 Build InfoPath web-form solutions, possible using code-back in VB .NET 

 Build SSRS, PowerPivot, PowerView, and/or PerformancePoint reports 

 Track down and solve various SharePoint production issues reported by customers 

 Meet with business customers to get technical requirements which will allow the creation of SharePoint solutions 

 
 Qualifications: 
 Pursuing a BS or MS degree related to…, or a recent graduate 
 SharePoint 2013 preferred (SharePoint 2010 acceptable) 

 Microsoft BI Stack (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS) 

 Microsoft SQL Server (SSMS, Tabular Models) 

 Need to be strong with SQL/BI stack  

 Visio 

 Professional demeanor 

 Self-motivated, good organizational skills, detail-oriented, ability to prioritize, multi-task and meet deadlines 

 
 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration : 12+ months 
 Candidate should be in Bay Area
